description: Trait implementing common functionality for HTTP request and response messages in GuzzleHttp PSR-7 library.

methods.name: withProtocolVersion
methods.description: Returns a new instance with the specified protocol version.

methods.name: getHeaders
methods.description: Returns all headers as an array.

methods.name: getHeader
methods.description: Retrieves all values for a header.

methods.name: getHeaderLine
methods.description: Returns all header values as a comma-separated string.

methods.name: withHeader
methods.description: Returns a new instance with the specified header set.

methods.name: withAddedHeader
methods.description: Returns a new instance with an added header value.

methods.name: withoutHeader
methods.description: Returns a new instance without the specified header.

methods.name: getBody
methods.description: Returns the message body as a StreamInterface.

methods.name: withBody
methods.description: Returns a new instance with the specified body stream.
